workflow.components_intro: The browser communicates with the C backend. The backend updates the registry and coordinates HTTPS checks, reminders and email delivery.
workflow.monitor_copy: OpenSSL retrieves the certificate served by the endpoint and compares its SHA-256 fingerprint with the registry.
workflow.service_result: Results and anomalies in the registry
workflow.queue_copy: Reminders for contacts and renewed certificates for technical contacts. Messages wait for an enabled SMTP transport.
workflow.live_copy: While serve or watch is running, checks continue even with the browser closed. Desktop notifications require the page to remain open.
workflow.timing_monitor_value: 15 minutes by default · from 1 to 1440 minutes
workflow.lifecycle_intro: Choose how to obtain the certificate, assign contacts and configure the endpoints to monitor.
workflow.lifecycle_diagram: Diagram of the certificate management lifecycle
workflow.acquire_copy: Upload a PEM or DER file, or check an HTTPS URL or a specific, resolvable hostname.
workflow.register_copy: Import extracts CN, SAN, dates and fingerprint, and reconstructs the available CA chain. Duplicates retain their contacts and history.
workflow.assign_copy: Save one or more people for each role and associate the URLs to monitor with the certificate.
workflow.check_copy: The backend tracks expiry dates and compares the certificate served by each endpoint with the expected one.
workflow.reminders_copy: Default thresholds are 45, 30, 15, 2 and 0 days, customisable per certificate with an escalation contact. The predecessor continues generating reminders until retirement.
workflow.alerts_title: URL anomalies → alerts in the interface
workflow.alerts_copy: Unreachable services, TLS errors, unexpected certificates and recovery create events. Emails are optional per service and require SMTP; changes are never accepted automatically as renewals.
workflow.import_note_copy: The check does not request an HTTP page. You can inspect or download the certificate, then explicitly add it to the registry: a 15-minute monitor is prepared. For file imports, configure monitoring manually.
workflow.renewal_intro: The CA signs the new certificate. Certificate Manager registers and distributes it; the technician installs it on the service.
workflow.renewal_diagram: Diagram of certificate renewal and distribution
workflow.renew_obtain: Obtain the renewal from the CA
workflow.renew_obtain_copy: The new certificate must already be valid, expire later than the previous one and retain the same DNS/IP identities; without those SANs, the CN is compared.
workflow.renew_upload: Upload it from the old certificate
workflow.renew_upload_copy: Use the preview to link the renewal to its predecessor. Both remain valid in the registry: contacts are copied and monitors remain attached to the installed certificate.
workflow.renew_queue_copy: A message is queued for each technical contact, with the signed public certificate and available chain attached as PEM.
workflow.renew_install_copy: After delivery, the technician installs the new certificate and requests a check for each URL. Completion requires valid TLS and the correct fingerprint on every endpoint; only then is the previous certificate archived.
workflow.smtp_note_copy: Test connection checks TLS and authentication without sending email. Sending requires a saved and enabled configuration; up to five automatic attempts are made in total.
workflow.boundary_title: The registry tracks the renewal; the service needs updating
workflow.boundary_copy: The program does not issue, sign or install certificates and stores no TLS private keys. During transition it recognises the previous certificate and approved renewals; unexpected certificates still raise anomalies.
workflow.status_copy: Sent means acceptance by the SMTP server, not confirmation of delivery to the mailbox.
m_903cdd538897: See how the interface, registry, checks and email delivery work together.
flow.preview_help: Check identities, CAs and dates before saving. Multiple valid certificates may share the same CN.
flow.csv_help: Up to 100 rows. Columns: url, business_name, business_email, technical_name, technical_email. Separate multiple people with semicolons. Edit the text and retry after errors.
flow.csv_quote_error: Invalid CSV: check quotes and separators.
flow.csv_empty: Add a header and at least one data row.
flow.csv_header: A url column is required; headers must be unique.
flow.csv_limit: A maximum of 100 rows is allowed.
flow.csv_columns: Column count does not match the header.
flow.csv_unverified: TLS verification did not pass: review the result before importing.
flow.csv_validated: Rows analyzed: {0}. Choose rows to check.
flow.csv_stopped: Stopped. Previously imported rows remain in the registry.
flow.csv_size: The CSV file must be smaller than 1 MiB.
flow.duplicate: Already registered: ID {0}. Contacts and history are preserved.
flow.missing_chain: Incomplete chain. Add the missing CA certificates; issuer to locate: {0}. A complete chain does not establish operating-system trust.
flow.link_previous: Link as renewal of {0} · ID {1} · expires {2}
flow.overlap_help: Validity and installation are separate. The previous certificate stays active and monitored until deployment of the new one is verified on every endpoint.
flow.ca_no_case: Renewal cases apply to service certificates.
flow.deployment_help: Each URL is verified separately. Completion requires a fresh TLS check after the request and the new certificate fingerprint on all endpoints.
flow.no_endpoints: No endpoints linked. Manual retirement requires an owner and notes and does not constitute deployment verification.
flow.retire_confirm: Confirm that the previous certificate is no longer used? It will be archived without endpoint verification.
flow.policy_help: Day thresholds separated by commas; 0 means expiry. Escalation notifies a second contact after the configured delay. Previous certificates stay monitored during transition.
flow.assignment_help: Selections are added to existing contacts. Directory changes propagate to assignments.
flow.people_help: One address per person. Editing a name or email also updates assigned certificates.
flow.groups_help: Assign a group to multiple certificates. Membership changes also update group assignments.
flow.delete_person_confirm: Delete {0} from contacts? Review assignments after removal.
flow.monitor_email_help: Sending requires enabled SMTP. Repeated identical faults are deduplicated; recovery creates a new alert.

flow.csv_schema_help: Use these exact headers. url is required; the other columns are optional. Separate columns with commas and multiple people in the same cell with semicolons, keeping names and email addresses in the same order.
flow.csv_fix_rows: Correct rows with errors or exclude them from the selection before checking URLs.
flow.csv_contact_count: A certificate can have at most 100 contacts.

flow.x_background_help: The batch is saved on the server. Checks and approved imports continue after closing the browser while the program is running.

incident.title: Incident and maintenance workflows
incident.options_help: Checks continue during maintenance while email is paused. A fresh check is requested when maintenance ends. Unexpected certificates always appear immediately on this page.
incident.invalid_window: Enter both maintenance dates, with the end after the start.
incident.claims_help: Owner, notes and due date are separate from the technical result and read acknowledgement. Only a service check can record recovery.
incident.claim_saved: Ownership saved. The technical result remains the last check outcome.
incident.claim_does_not_recover: Completing the work does not confirm service recovery.
incident.changed_help: Acquire the observed certificate, compare it with the registry and consider linking a renewal case. An unknown fingerprint is never approved automatically.
m_ca067eb7c694: Plan requests, renewals and installations and track overdue tasks.
ops.compare_help: Compare identities, CAs, dates and fingerprints before linking a replacement.
ops.compatible: This certificate can be linked as a replacement.
ops.incompatible: This certificate does not meet renewal requirements. Check identity and validity.
ops.checklist_help: Every service, including paused ones, must confirm the replacement with valid TLS. The request and evidence must be from the last 15 minutes.
ops.ready_close: All checks allow closure. The server will repeat them before saving.
ops.blocked_close: This case cannot be closed yet. Resolve the listed conditions.
ops.checklist_validity: Evaluated at {0}. Evidence expires after 15 minutes.
ops.evidence_expired: Evidence has expired: request a new installation check.
ops.delivery_help: “Accepted by SMTP” means the mail server accepted the message. Receipt and installation require separate checks.
ops.no_technical_recipients: No technical contacts are assigned to this replacement.
ops.report_help: The JSON report contains certificates, fingerprints, services, deliveries and history. Closure retains an evidence snapshot, distinguishing verified installation from manual retirement.
ops.reminder_preview_help: Try the draft rule before saving it. Simulation creates no email and records no notified thresholds.
ops.draft_changed: The form has changed: run the simulation again.
ops.directory_help: These are the current affected assignments. The change may update shared contacts, monitor recipients and queued messages. Sent-message history is retained.
ops.agenda_help: All open and closed cases, with owners and planned dates. Overdue planned installation is flagged even while the certificate remains valid.
ops.templates_help: Save reusable rules and apply them to multiple certificates after reviewing the changes. Selected exceptions keep their current rule.
ops.delete_template_confirm: Delete this template? Rules already applied to certificates are retained.
ops.template_applied: Template applied to included certificates. Exceptions preserved.
ops.save_template_first: Select a saved template; save any draft changes first.
ops.review_ready: Review ready. Apply after checking recipients, thresholds and exceptions.
ops.exceptions_help: Select certificates and explicitly mark exceptions to preserve. The review shows both categories.
ops.unsaved_template: Save or discard template changes before changing language.
ops.audit_help: Latest 500 local operations: changes, assignments and deliveries. The local application does not authenticate the operator’s identity.
ops.event_superseded: Superseded by a recorded more urgent threshold
ops.event_skipped: Skipped: the most urgent reached threshold is used
ops.reason_replacement_not_valid: The replacement is archived, expired or not yet valid.
ops.reason_no_endpoints: No services to verify: configure a URL or consider manual retirement with a note.
ops.reason_endpoint_checks_incomplete: One or more services fail the checklist.
ops.reason_duplicate_targets: The same URL is assigned to both certificates: resolve duplicates.
ops.reason_tls_not_verified: TLS chain or service identity not verified.
ops.reason_service_not_ok: Service does not have a successful technical result.
ops.reason_fingerprint_mismatch: Observed fingerprint differs from the expected replacement.
ops.reason_association_changed: Service is now assigned to another certificate.
flow.x_changed_help: Compare the observed certificate with the registry. Import a candidate and explicitly confirm its renewal link. Anomalies are never approved automatically.
flow.x_incompatible: Certificates are incompatible for this renewal.
mailTemplates.title: Email templates by alert and recipient
mailTemplates.intro: Choose an alert and recipient group to customize the subject and message. Default messages are in Italian and can be rewritten in any language.
mailTemplates.future_only: Changes apply only to new messages. Emails already queued retain their original text and recipients.
mailTemplates.self_settings_help: Enter the address that will receive enabled copies for “Me”. This setting does not change the SMTP sender or certificate contacts.
mailTemplates.settings_saved: Personal recipient saved. Delivery depends on the copies enabled for each alert.
mailTemplates.subject: Subject
mailTemplates.copy_enabled: Also send a copy to this group
mailTemplates.copy_other_help: Other recipients use the routing already configured for monitoring or escalation; no copies are added.
mailTemplates.copy_self_help: Enable an additional copy to your personal address for this alert. Original recipients are unchanged.
mailTemplates.copy_group_help: Enable an additional copy to certificate contacts in this group. Leaving this unchecked does not remove existing deliveries.
mailTemplates.variables_help: Click a variable to insert it into the active field. Use double braces; unknown variables are rejected. The message body is plain text.
mailTemplates.field_too_long: The variable exceeds the field’s maximum length.
mailTemplates.saved: Template saved. It will be used for new messages for this alert and group.
mailTemplates.reset_help: The selected template will return to its default text and additional copies will be disabled. The draft for this combination will be deleted; other combinations will be unchanged.
mailTemplates.reset_done: Template restored and additional copies disabled.
mailTemplates.drafts_preserved: Drafts retained in this tab: {0}. You can switch alert and group without losing them.
mailTemplates.preview_help: Preview the draft without saving or sending email. You can use fictional sample data or registry data.
mailTemplates.preview_ready: Preview ready. No email was sent and no changes were saved.
mailTemplates.sample_preview: Fictional data and recipient, used for preview only.
mailTemplates.certificate_preview: Registry data; the recipient name and address are preview examples, not actual delivery addresses.
mailTemplates.attachment_yes: This alert includes the public certificate as an attachment; no private key.
mailTemplates.attachment_no: This alert has no certificate attachment.
mailTemplates.smtp_help: “Sent” means accepted by the SMTP server: it does not confirm that the message was read or the certificate installed.
mailTemplates.unsaved_help: Save or discard drafts before changing language. Drafts remain available in this tab while navigating.
mailTemplates.busy_help: Wait for the operation to finish before changing language.
mailTemplates.audience_self_help: Template for the personal recipient configured on this page.
mailTemplates.audience_business_help: Template used when a message is addressed to the certificate’s business contacts.
mailTemplates.audience_technical_help: Template used when a message is addressed to the certificate’s technical contacts.
mailTemplates.audience_other_help: Template for explicit monitoring or escalation addresses that do not belong to the other groups.
